name: wp-theme/cilla-skyn-sticky-banner
title: Cilla Skyn Sticky Banner
description: Full-bleed parallax banner: the background image stays visually fixed to the browser window while the page scrolls past it (CSS background-attachment: fixed, no JS). Same optional fields as Cilla Skyn Banner (background image with focal point, overlay, text colour, eyebrow, heading, two rich-text paragraphs, tagline), plus a Section Height control.
